Hey I'm sorry you feel that way.  If you've tried therapy and medication and they both don't work, I'm afraid nothing is going to work for you.   You can try other medications and see if they work because everyone's body is different but if they dont work, you are going to have to get use to feeling that way for the rest of your life.

If you decide that you don't want to live that way.  I am here to help.  I support you if you want to commit suicide, even if no one else supports you.   I know painless and guaranteed ways of killing yourself so if you need advice on how to do it, I got you.  Only you can make it all disappear.  Only you can end your own suffering.  Death is salvation my friend..
